sql:
WITH
actuals AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
quotas AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS sales_amount_quota
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
store_attainment AS (
    SELECT
        s.StoreKey,
        ds.StoreName,
        a.actual_sales,
        q.sales_amount_quota,
        a.actual_sales / nullIf(q.sales_amount_quota, 0) AS quota_attainment
    FROM actuals a
    INNER JOIN quotas q ON a.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimStore ds ON a.StoreKey = ds.StoreKey
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY quota_attainment DESC, StoreKey) AS top_rank,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY quota_attainment ASC, StoreKey) AS bottom_rank
    FROM store_attainment
)
SELECT
    if(top_rank <= 5, 'Top 5', 'Bottom 5') AS performer_group,
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    sales_amount_quota,
    quota_attainment
FROM ranked
WHERE top_rank <= 5 OR bottom_rank <= 5
ORDER BY performer_group DESC, quota_attainment DESC, StoreKey
